messages:
maria: Heads-up — PR 51234 is ready for cross-team eyes. It touches routing fallback, eviction config, and adds a KMS rotation step. Link: https://git.company/redwood/pull/51234. Need runtime + platform + infra + security sign-offs. Can folks self-assign? Target merge: Thu 22:00 UTC (merge window).

quentin: Looking. Do we need perf numbers? If runtime needs numbers I can run a 5m perf job.

tina: infra - I can review eviction + disk/oom handling. FYI if this changes eviction thresholds we'll need a rolling restart plan. ping @ryan for KV cache impacts.

ryan: runtime - yep. Will need a small perf run and check that kv-cache TTLs are unchanged. Also want to run a quick synthetic with seq_len=1024. Where's the perf script?

maria: perf script is at infra/tests/perf/run_local.sh. snippet: ```bash
./run_local.sh --model redwood-3b --seq 1024 --requests 200
``` Artifacts in CI + perf logs attached in the PR.

ci-bot: CI passed — unit tests 135/135, integration smoke ok. E2E failing on canary-only test (flaky) — see details: https://ci.company/2345

quentin: I'll queue a perf run now. ETA ~15m.

alex: security - quick Q: PR mentions a KMS rotation step — does this change any IAM roles or introduce plaintext creds? Also need a short threat-model paragraph for the PR description.

maria: No plaintext creds. Adds a post-deploy rotate via KMS API role we already use. Added threat-model blurb to PR: 'rotation uses existing KMS roles; no new permissions; audit logs enabled'

sophie: platform - I can own canary rollout and monitor cost/latency. If runtime and infra are +1 I'll coordinate canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Also need to know if fallback routing changes require config migration.

tina: If eviction threshold changed we'll want a config migration. If only defaults updated we can avoid migration. Maria, which?

maria: only default lowered for batch eviction threshold (from 0.6->0.55). No DB schema changes, no config format changes.

ryan: perf run done — 5% p90 token latency regression on 1024 seq for redwood-3b. I'll post CSV to PR. Might be acceptable but flagging.

quentin: can you paste the exact numbers? Our SLO is +<10%.

ryan: p50 no change, p90 +5.2%, p95 +6.1%. Details in PR artifacts.

alex: security ok with KMS rotation given no new roles and audit logs. +1 pending infra checks.

tina: infra +1 on eviction config. no rolling restarts needed; we'll apply via configmap canary.

sophie: platform +1 to canary and merge plan. I'll schedule canary at 08:00 UTC and monitor dashboards.

maria: thanks all — plan: merge Thu 22:00 UTC if no regressions after canary. assigning reviewers: @ryan (runtime), @tina (infra), @alex (security), @sophie (platform).

quentin: I'll defer to runtime on merge gating. Good luck :thumbsup:

maria: CI note: e2e flaky unrelated. Will re-run pre-merge. tagging @ci-bot to re-run e2e before merge.

ci-bot: E2E re-run scheduled, will post status.
